_comment: Codex-isolated ChromeMCP endpoint. This keeps Codex on its own MCP ports, CDP port, token file, and Windows Chrome profile so it does not drive the default Claude/shared ChromeMCP instance. Start with 'chromemcp codex-bridge', 'chromemcp codex-chrome', then 'chromemcp codex-up'. SUBSTITUTE <TOKEN> with the output of 'MCP_TOKEN_PATH=~/.config/chromemcp-codex/token chromemcp token'.
